summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.39/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.39 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 24, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 18. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ higher than a week ago, 14¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.68 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($4.02) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.75).
